policy: Paired supervised personal calibration, not unlabeled TTT. Fixed 100 steps and LR, no target-query model selection. Derived support/query split; original benchmark files unchanged.

query_policy.bcic_2a: T session support, entire E session query

unsupported: PhysioMI 20 shots/class is not attempted: early-run calibration pool is too small. No replacement sampling to pretend additional independent trials.
validation_policy: Smoke uses validation subjects only; formal evaluation uses held-out test subjects with separately authorized support labels. No query labels used in updates, preprocessing, stopping, or hyperparameter selection.
